New `MeetingSystemAudioSignalVerdict.swift` classifies a session as `.silent` when system buffers arrive but are exact digital zero (with microphone-nonzero and ≥30s-duration guards); `MeetingCaptureHealth.swift` surfaces `.stalled`/`.silent`/`.recovering` statuses in the UI as a 'Partial audio' badge.
issues.reason: Candidate adds detection/reporting so a failed capture is no longer silently reported as a full success (arguably the more severe underlying defect), but does not fix the intermittent ScreenCaptureKit capture failure itself, which remains hardware-unproven for Teams specifically.
issues.next_action: Cannot close as hardware-proven fixed; keep open pending a real Teams-call verification. The 'silent success masking' bug is fixed; the capture-reliability bug is not.

issues.evidence: OpenCodeRequestHeaders.apply sends an opaque per-conversation UUID only to documented HTTPS Go endpoints through both existing HTTP adapters. Its redirect delegate now refuses unapproved destinations entirely, protecting credentials and prompt bodies. Adapter/lifecycle tests and a synthetic redirect reproduction passed; no live OpenCode Go credential/provider validation was performed.
issues.reason: The prior ledger evidence (zero hits, unimplemented, P0 release-blocker) was stale: it contradicted this same audit's own summary table, which already recorded the header as adapter/lifecycle-verified. Source presence plus a passing adversarial test establishes candidate-side implementation; without a live-provider run this is fixed-in-candidate, not release-blocking, and not yet main-verified.
issues.next_action: Associate with the final PR and CI; confirm the header reaches OpenCode Go in a live/manual smoke before closing the underlying GitHub issue.

issues.evidence: Reporter describes unprompted dictation cancellation (with the undo/countdown UX) during hands-free mode without pressing Escape or the hotkey again, resulting in unrecoverable loss of the transcription (confirmed not recoverable via the app). Code trace: DictationFlowCoordinator.cancelDictation(reason:) (App/DictationFlowCoordinator.swift:359-364) is only found wired to the Escape-key handler (App/AppEnvironmentConfigurer.swift:419-421, onCancelDictation → reason: .escape); no automatic or configuration-change-triggered cancel path was located in this pass.
issues.reason: High-severity data-loss bug (each occurrence destroys an entire dictation with no recovery) acknowledged by the owner the same day as 'not expected', but the spurious trigger's source is unconfirmed in code — could be an input-device/hotkey conflict misfiring an escape-equivalent gesture rather than a regression in this candidate.
issues.next_action: Urgent: needs a targeted trace of every path (FnKeyStateMachine, hotkey conflict resolution, media-pause coordinator) that can reach cancelRequested(reason:), plus the reporter's exact keyboard/hotkey configuration; treat as a release-readiness risk given the destructive, unrecoverable outcome even though root cause is unconfirmed.

issues.evidence: Reporter supplied a synchronous CoreML/ANE compile wait chain (MacParakeet → aned → compiler service), persistent across relaunch, with recovery after a system-daemon/cache workaround. Current WhisperEngine.prepareLocked awaits WhisperKit(WhisperKitConfig(load:true, download:false)); makePrepareWatchdog emits progress at 15/60/180/300 seconds only and does not terminate or recover a blocked load.
issues.reason: This is a newly reported model-preparation stall, not covered by the candidate onboarding error-classification changes: a blocked load never returns an error for those handlers. The supplied process trace is accepted; no reproduction or hardware-fix claim from this review.
issues.next_action: Keep open as a release risk. Define a bounded stalled-load presentation without releasing still-owned model/ANE resources; investigate safe compute-unit fallback separately. Do not automatically kill system-wide aned or delete shared compiler caches. Correlate the actual OS/build (body vs generated metadata differ) and capture the downstream compiler-service trace if available.
